channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Luna urges background checks for Congress and staff
item.description: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna reiterated her call for background checks on lawmakers and staff after new details emerged about former Rep. Eric Swalwell.

item.title: DOJ official calls gun rights restoration 'very American'
item.description: U.S. Pardon Attorney Ed Martin praised a new Justice Department process that allows some previously barred individuals to seek restoration of gun rights.

item.title: Trump backs replacement GOP nominee after Edwards exits race
item.description: President Trump endorsed state Rep. Jennifer Balkcom as the new GOP nominee for a U.S. House seat after Rep. Chuck Edwards withdrew from the race.

item.title: Socialist challenger targets pro-Israel Democrats in Florida primary
item.description: DSA-backed Oliver Larkin is challenging Rep. Jared Moskowitz in Florida's 25th District, highlighting a growing left-center divide within the Democratic Party.
